description: This file defines a mock class 'MediaPipelineServerInternalFactoryMock' for unit testing, which implements the 'IMediaPipelineServerInternalFactory' interface. It provides mock methods to create media pipeline objects and internal server objects, used in testing media pipeline components within the Rialto server project.

classes.name: MediaPipelineServerInternalFactoryMock
classes.description: Mock class implementing IMediaPipelineServerInternalFactory for testing purposes.

methods.name: createMediaPipeline
methods.description: Mock method to create a media pipeline, taking a weak pointer to IMediaPipelineClient and video requirements.

methods.name: createMediaPipelineServerInternal
methods.description: Mock method to create an internal media pipeline server, with parameters including client weak pointer, video requirements, session ID, shared memory buffer, and decryption service.
